title: maint.event.v1{kind=spool_flush_acks_reconciled}
description: Phase 8 §8.16.2 — emitted by SpoolAckReconciler (inside maint.dlq.v1) once all expected per-consumer acks have landed for a spool-flush invocation, OR the cfg.opsctl_spool_ack_max_wait_h deadline has elapsed. Notification-only; no ack expected.

target.description: Agent or subsystem whose spool-flush triggered this reconciliation (e.g. 'opsctl').

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

flush_invocation_id.description: Unique ID for the spool-flush invocation being reconciled (UUID4).

request_id.description: The maint.event.v1 request_id that was flushed from spool.

expected_ack_count.description: Number of per-consumer acks expected for this flush invocation.

received_ack_count.description: Number of per-consumer acks received before emission.

complete.description: True when all expected acks landed; false when deadline elapsed before full ack set.

missing_ack_consumers.description: accepted_by values for consumers that did not ack before deadline. Empty when complete=true.
